description: File extensions the two module graphs compile into a module.
why: crates/ruvyxa_bundler/src/compiler.rs resolves and compiles the client graph; packages/ruvyxa/runtime/compiler.mjs does the same for the server and prerender graph. Each keeps its own list because neither can import the other's, and a project is built by whichever graph owns that lane. An extension one accepts and the other refuses is a build that succeeds on the client and fails at prerender with RUV1806 naming a dependency the application never wrote.
note: Both hosts match case-insensitively: sources with an upper-case extension exist on case-insensitive filesystems, and rejecting them in one graph only would be the same divergence in a costume. `extensions` is the canonical lower-case spelling; `acceptedCasing` pins the folding.
